conditions.keep_unclear: OFF arrival gate on 94 PN/LN edges, retain 22 unclear edges
conditions.block_all: OFF arrival gate on all 116 PN/LN edges, including 22 unclear

pilot.purpose: Verify scope, ON preservation, OFF windows, restoration, and control equivalence; no efficacy-based parameter search

gate_time: ARRIVAL time, not source emission. Full arrival input is reconstructed before integration. Both OFF periods only. No v/g reset, weight edit, or suppression of other edges. All ON arrivals pass, including those emitted in preceding OFF. ReON trajectory may differ because OFF history changed.
interpretation: Report paired absolute and relative changes continuously. Do not equate tiny PN changes with quiescence. All ten ORNs <=3Hz and PN <=3Hz indicates quiet in this protocol; ORN silence with persistently high PN means this return path is not necessary for sustained PN. Incomplete ORN silencing does not meet that discriminator. No sufficiency claim.
